exposure: ureteral flexion on drop infusion pyelography (DIP)
outcome: operation time to complete laparoscopic hysterectomy (LH)
cohort: The study included 407 patients who underwent laparoscopic hysterectomy (LH) for benign uterine diseases in a hospital between 2013 and 2022.
finding: Multivariate analysis identified endometriosis, obliteration of Douglas' pouch, and ureteral flexion on drop infusion pyelography (DIP) as significant predictors for periureteral adhesions, with DIP being the most accurate diagnostic tool.
